_doc: Machine-readable owner-REJECTED visual treatments. Read by scripts/hooks/mockup-resurrection-gate.py (PreToolUse on Write/Edit under public/_mockups/). Source code containing a treatment is NOT proof it is current: dormant branches resurrect rejected taste (the 2026-07-15 rose-badge incident, owner: 'you keep reading from the source code... you keep making it in over and over again'). When the owner rejects a treatment, ADD AN ENTRY HERE the same turn (the visual twin of REMOVED.md). Matching: block if every regex in all_of matches the incoming file content (case-insensitive), and, when present, at least one regex in any_of also matches; exclude_paths substrings exempt specific files.

entries.why: Owner rejected rose/red photo tags for discounts twice: the mobile decision (memory project_card_badges: 'isn't it weird', rejected red/rose/ink/glass, discount = pale-green by the price) and again on sight in the taste lab ('doesnt match at all'). The web DiscountBadge (SalonCard.tsx V3-D85) is dormant code that never renders live; do not copy it into mockups or new UI.

entries.why: Owner declined web dark mode ('no dark mode', Taste Lab round 1). Mobile Revolut-charcoal stays the only dark surface. Do not build dark web mockups without a new owner yes.
Tracked-uppercase labels/eyebrows are on the mockup banned list (owner-rejected repeatedly; CLAUDE.md copy-economy rule 5). Normal-case 13px semibold instead.
Placeholder junk in mockup status bars (three filled dots) is owner-rejected; use the kit's signal/wifi/battery glyphs.
